```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR

    class Safelist {
        -Set~TagName~ tagNames
        -Map attributes
        -Map enforcedAttributes
        -Map protocols
        -boolean preserveRelativeLinks
        +none()$ Safelist
        +simpleText()$ Safelist
        +basic()$ Safelist
        +basicWithImages()$ Safelist
        +relaxed()$ Safelist
        +Safelist()
        +Safelist(Safelist copy)
        +addTags(String... tags) Safelist
        +removeTags(String... tags) Safelist
        +addAttributes(String tag, String... attributes) Safelist
        +removeAttributes(String tag, String... attributes) Safelist
        +addEnforcedAttribute(String tag, String attribute, String value) Safelist
        +removeEnforcedAttribute(String tag, String attribute) Safelist
        +preserveRelativeLinks(boolean preserve) Safelist
        +preserveRelativeLinks() boolean
        +addProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... protocols) Safelist
        +removeProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... removeProtocols) Safelist
        +isSafeTag(String tag) boolean
        +isSafeAttribute(String tagName, Element el, Attribute attr) boolean
        +getEnforcedAttributes(String tagName) Attributes
    }

    class TypedValue {
        <<abstract>>
        -String value
        +hashCode() int
        +equals(Object obj) boolean
        +toString() String
    }

    class TagName {
        <<static nested>>
        +valueOf(String value)$ TagName
    }

    class AttributeKey {
        <<static nested>>
        +valueOf(String value)$ AttributeKey
    }

    class AttributeValue {
        <<static nested>>
        +valueOf(String value)$ AttributeValue
    }

    class Protocol {
        <<static nested>>
        +valueOf(String value)$ Protocol
    }

    class Cleaner {
        -Safelist safelist
        +Cleaner(Safelist safelist)
    }

    class CleaningVisitor["Cleaner.CleaningVisitor"] {
        <<inner>>
    }

    class Jsoup {
        <<utility>>
        +clean(String bodyHtml, Safelist safelist)$ String
        +clean(String bodyHtml, String baseUri, Safelist safelist)$ String
        +clean(String bodyHtml, String baseUri, Safelist safelist, Document.OutputSettings outputSettings)$ String
        +isValid(String bodyHtml, Safelist safelist)$ boolean
    }

    class Element
    class Attribute
    class Attributes

    class Validate {
        <<utility>>
    }

    class Normalizer {
        <<utility>>
    }

    %% Safelist nested value types
    TypedValue <|-- TagName
    TypedValue <|-- AttributeKey
    TypedValue <|-- AttributeValue
    TypedValue <|-- Protocol
    Safelist *-- TagName : tagNames / attributes keys
    Safelist *-- AttributeKey : attribute sets
    Safelist *-- AttributeValue : enforced values
    Safelist *-- Protocol : allowed protocols

    %% What Safelist uses
    Safelist ..> Element : isSafeAttribute param
    Safelist ..> Attribute : isSafeAttribute param
    Safelist ..> Attributes : getEnforcedAttributes returns
    Safelist ..> Validate : argument checks
    Safelist ..> Normalizer : case normalization
    Attributes "1" *-- "*" Attribute

    %% Types that use Safelist
    Cleaner *-- Safelist : safelist field
    CleaningVisitor ..> Safelist : calls isSafeAttribute
    Cleaner *-- CleaningVisitor : inner class
    Jsoup ..> Safelist : clean / isValid params
    Jsoup ..> Cleaner : creates
```
